view_title: Column grid master for บ้านต้านภัยพิบัติแผ่นดินไหว 1 (แบบบ้านสานฝัน ของขวัญปีใหม่ คนไทยมีความสุข) -- derived from S-02 แปลนฐานรากแผ่ (PNG 23 / printed 21). Main grid 4 x 6, 9.60 m x 14.55 m overall, plus 4 dummy x-lines and 1 dummy y-line required by the S-04 porch/partition beams, positions printed on A-04.

warnings: BOTH DIMENSION CHAINS CLOSE. x: 3.20 + 3.20 + 3.20 = 9.60 = the printed overall 9.60 on S-02 (verified digit-by-digit at ~3x zoom). y (bottom A to top F): 3.15 + 1.80 + 3.60 + 2.00 + 4.00 = 14.55 = the printed overall 14.55 on S-02 (verified at ~3x zoom). The identical chains are printed again on S-03, S-04, S-05, S-06, A-04, SN-04, SN-05, EE-03, EE-04 and M-01 -- 11 sheets agree, zero disagree. SN/EE sheets additionally print the site chains 15.60 (= A + 1.00 + 9.60 + 1.00 + A) and 19.65, which independently re-confirm the 1.00 m porch dummies 1'/4'.

NO DRAWING BREAK LINES ANYWHERE IN THIS SET. Checked explicitly per the house-06 lesson with ~4.5x tight crops of line mid-spans: S-02 vertical grid lines (2 full-width bands, bays C-D and E-F), S-04 (E-D band, F-E band, south carport region), S-05 (porch + south roof), A-04 wall runs (row-C south wall band + grid-1 west wall full height). All lines are continuous; the whole 9.60 x 14.55 building fits at 1:100 on every sheet (CAD set dated 19/10/59), so nothing needed breaking. Stage 2 may trust every dimension chain as continuous.

DUMMY GRID RATIONALE (beam-endpoint rule, schema §4): 5 dummy lines, every pos_m read from a printed dimension, none estimated. 1' = -1.00 (negative: sits before origin grid 1, per §4's negative-pos rule) and 4' = 10.60 carry the E->D porch edge beams (B1 on S-04, RB0 on S-05) and the B2X/RB1X row-E/row-D extensions end on them; printed 1.00 + 1.00 on A-04's top chain and re-printed inside SN-04/EE-03/EE-04's 15.60 site chain. 2' = 1.90 and 3' = 7.70 carry the interior E->D B1 verticals (bathroom WC.1/WC.2 partition lines); printed as 1.90|1.30 and 1.30|1.90 sub-chains on A-04, and the S-04 drawn positions match (~1.88-1.90 m by pixel check at 78.3 px/m). F' = 13.65 carries the S-04 B2 beam under the kitchen north wall, bay 1-2 only; printed as 3.10 above grid E on A-04 (drawn position on S-04 pixel-checks to ~0.97-1.03 m below F vs the printed 0.90 -- within beam-face/line-width tolerance; the printed 3.10 wins per the never-estimate rule).

PRIME NAMING FOLLOWS THE NEAREST-MAIN-GRID RULE (§4): 2' is the line 1.30 m LEFT of grid 2 (nearer to 2 than to 1), and 3' is the line 1.30 m RIGHT of grid 3 (nearer to 3 than to 4). Do not misread a prime as always sitting to the right of its base grid. Only one dummy falls in any gap, so no double primes were needed.

LINES DELIBERATELY NOT GIVEN DUMMY GRIDS (slab-only-edge rule, §4): the ST2/ซักล้าง stub north of F (stair + washing slab, located by A-04's 0.40|2.70|0.10 chain -- no beams, no columns, S-04 draws only the stair flight); the เฉลียง south edge (its B1 beam sits exactly ON grid B between B-2 and B-3 -- verified against the row-B grid line at 4x); the carport SO slabs including the 1.60 m strip south of grid A (slab-on-ground edges, thin single lines, no beams/columns at the south corners; 1.60 printed on A-04's left chain); and every roof eave line (steel roof edges 1.50 north of F, 1.50 + 0.30 south of C, 1.30 beyond grids 1/4 per S-06/SN-05 -- eave edges carry no beam).

Single building only -- one grid system repeated identically across architectural, structural, sanitary, electrical and mechanical sheets. §11a multi-building handling not needed; no lettered second grid master exists.

Y-ORIGIN CONVENTION: A = 0.00 at the BOTTOM edge of every plan as drawn, increasing upward to F = 14.55 (same convention as house 07's grid master, where row A is also the south edge). x origin: grid 1 = 0.00 at the left edge, increasing right to grid 4 = 9.60.
